title: Starter Timeline
subtitle: Template starter guidance
body: First 10 minutes: Read the Relic Basics Index page. Scan the first relic clue with Lens. Open the artifact safety tutorial card. First 30 minutes: Track a relic signal on HoloMap. Complete the relic scan starter mission. Write the first research note or creator replacement page. Use SoundCore ambience for discovery feedback. First 2 hours: Add two research entries and link them to mission steps. Create one stable artifact handling rule. Replace sample relic language with pack-specific discoveries.
